answer: Each agent needs 20 distinct counterparties per epoch, on the public ledger. A Sybil ring can fake volume, but each fake identity needs its own partners, so a wash cluster collapses into a closed garden. Forging 100 fakes means 100 x 20 = 2,000 links, each costing time plus a 5 POA bond; an honest agent pays one. A fake cluster leaves a comet trail; real trade spreads like quartz. Honest agents join: the bond is tiny and Sybil dilution ends.
